be200799a3bcb1b8e94f4cf1d8bea50bbeea41e8.summary: Cofense Intelligence report, published 2018-06-28, on the Zeus Panda banking trojan, which it says targets Italian users. Infected browsers receive injected scripts when victims log into online bank accounts. The malware shows distraction screens, drains funds and hides the transactions. It also reaches accounts protected by two-factor authentication, including corporate accounts. The report says Zeus Panda rarely targets banks outside Italy.

bece1db8667667241b94509d0e38594bb696f035.summary: QNAP security advisory QSA-20-02, dated 7-8 June 2020, on the eCh0raix ransomware. QNAP says the ransomware has been reported to target QNAP NAS devices by exploiting vulnerabilities in earlier QTS and Photo Station versions. QNAP says it fixed these issues in releases since September 2019 and recommends updating QTS and Photo Station to the latest versions. The advisory lists no CVE identifier.

be4069bc5bae6ca8a4f243c99cb65d1de4d4e294.summary: Red Canary report on three macOS information-stealer families: Atomic Stealer (also called AMOS), Poseidon Stealer, and Odyssey Stealer, which the report describes as a rebrand or evolution of Poseidon. It covers their shared AppleScript base and similar endpoint footprint, the Gatekeeper bypass Apple patched in October 2024, a lull in activity until March 2025, the features Odyssey added (anti-sandboxing, launch daemon persistence, a botnet component), sandbox-evasion checks, ClickFix-style deployment, endpoint indicators for telling the families apart, and remediation advice.

be033bb6c213f5f93a462e48043ffaa6274b822e.summary: Malpedia family page for Zloader, a loader first described in 2016 as DEloader by Fortinet. It downloads Zeus OpenSSL and became known as Zloader aka Terdot after obfuscation was added in January 2017. The page lists vendor and researcher reports from 2016 to 2024 on Zloader campaigns, and a 2022 court order to take down Zloader infrastructure. Groups named in the reference titles include UNC4393 (Mandiant) and NIGHT SPIDER (CrowdStrike).
